dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bashi wata abun ya fito da nawa ne ya kamata muna bincika?
dialogue.translation: A news story just came out, how important is it that we check it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaushe mun zauna a ciki wata wata abun ba zan gaya masa ba, amma zan bayyana shi a yaushe.
dialogue.translation: So we can discuss it later, but I’ll explain it now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yanzu wata wata abun ya faru a yankin, ya kamata muna ganin mana.
dialogue.translation: Now a thing happened in the area, we must see it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Na san, akwai wasu mutane da suka fada wata wata abun da ba da lafiya ba.
dialogue.translation: I know, some people are talking about a matter that’s not good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe ba zan kwance ba, zan zo kuma in tuna masa da wata wata abun.
dialogue.translation: I won’t stay quiet, I’ll come and remind him of a thing.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yanzu ba zan iya yi wani aiki ba, kuma zan tuna da wata wata abun mai zurfi.
dialogue.translation: Now I can’t do any work, and I’ll remember a strong thing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Idan mun ji wata wata abun mai zurfi, za mu yi matsakaici da su.
dialogue.translation: If we hear a strong thing, we’ll discuss it with them.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of Hausa

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ba game ne game, amma karya ne wani karya. Fiye da haka, faɗi ba ko?
dialogue.translation: It's not exactly a problem, but it is an issue. Just say it, what do you think?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba ni da karya. Nawa ne mai kyau game?
dialogue.translation: I don't have a problem. How much is good enough?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Game da kwana soso, sai kwana guda. Wani ne mai kyau.
dialogue.translation: About two days, only one day. That is sufficient.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Amma ba zan iya ba. Fiye da kwana uku, ba zan iya ba.
dialogue.translation: But I can't do that. More than three days, I can't.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ba sawa. Ko kwana biyu ko kwana guda dai. Wani ne mai kyau.
dialogue.translation: No problem. Either two days or just one day. That's fine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Game ne. Sai kwana guda, amma ba zan ci gaba ba da wani problema.
dialogue.translation: Okay. Just one day, but I won't cause any other problems.

key_phrases.translation: It's not exactly a problem

key_phrases.phrase: Nawaye ne mai kyau game?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Na son sauke dimokradiya, watau na da tsammanin gajiya a gida ba zan gama ba. Ina son hadawa da mutanen da na fara ci karatu a wata sabon kasuwa.
dialogue.translation: I want to complete my degree, that is, I have the belief that I will not stop at home. I want to connect with people and start studying in a new market.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wannan sabuwar kasuwa, girma ce da sabis? Da yaushe ka shirya abin ba zan bari ba.
dialogue.translation: This new market, is it important and affordable? And when will you prepare the thing I won’t let go?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Baya nauyarku, zan kwalli kwanaki da yawa na yi ajiya. Anan ne zan gama karatu, amma zan ci gaba da hadawa da wasanni.
dialogue.translation: After your advice, I will save many days of rest. Here is where I will finish studying, but I will continue connecting with businesses.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Fahimta game da harshe, watau Hausa da Ingilishi, za ka iya samun manyan damar aiki a wannan sabuwar kasuwa. Wannan ke da sannu!
dialogue.translation: Understanding of language, that is Hausa and English, will give you a big opportunity to work in this new market. This is peaceful!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dole ne zan yi masu lissafin yin wakili don sake kara hadawa da mutanen da na fara ci karatu. Wannan ya kamata ne in sani harshen turanci.
dialogue.translation: I must do my best to continue connecting with people and start studying. It is necessary that I know the English language.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaya za ka maima da lamarin wannan? Idan ka ci gaba da hadawa, za ka iya samun wata sabis a cikin wannan sabuwar kasuwa.
dialogue.translation: How will you repeat this matter? If you continue connecting, you will be able to get an opportunity in this new market.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Na tsaya! Wannan sabuwar kasuwa ya wuce sannu saboda an samu damar aiki da wasanni. Ina fatan za ka iya kara haduwa da shi.
dialogue.translation: I stopped! This new market has passed peace because an opportunity for work and businesses was found. I hope you can continue connecting with it.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: It's difficult for us to keep up with remote work. According to my opinion, which aspect caused this?

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.text: Sai na sanin da muke samu wata sabis na fashe-wata aiki. Zai iya canzawa ga fashe-wata ba ne?
dialogue.translation: Then I can see the benefits we get from remote work. Isn't it about flexibility?

dialogue.text: Wata ra'ayi ce, amma shakku ne da yawa. Ina da shakku game da fashe-wata aiki saboda rana da dare.
dialogue.translation: It's an opinion, but there's a lot of doubt. I doubt remote work because of day and night differences.

dialogue.translation: This isn't a problem, we just need to adapt. We can find many ways to learn new things.

dialogue.speaker: Alhaji
dialogue.text: Na fada da kuma bayyana sa'an nan na ce muna da shakku cikin fahimta, amma, da yaushe. Zaku iya ba da wasu misalai?

dialogue.speaker: Alhaji
dialogue.text: To, in daga sabis ne akwai wannan matsala. Kuma abin da muna da shakka shine sabis ne ya zo daga waje.
dialogue.translation: Well, from the service itself comes this problem. Also the thing we doubt is that the service came from elsewhere.

dialogue.text: Yau ba zan tsaya har damu ba. Ina da ra'ayi da Allah.
dialogue.translation: Today I will not stand still out of concern. I have an opinion, God willing.
